steps.content: [Scene Change] Any Magnificent Hall
You listen intently, but the communicator offers only silence. Has the team lost contact? Did you send them down the wrong path? Is their sacrifice on your hands?
You need to go back. You have to—
Hey, focus.

The urgent thought shatters. You are pulled back into the shimmering glow of the ballroom, the soft strains of the waltz, and the captivating presence of the female general in crimson standing before you.
Catherine keeps one hand in yours, the other resting lightly on your shoulder. Her gaze holds a mixture of mild reproach and amusement.
steps.female_content: Catherine keeps one hand in yours, the other resting lightly on your waist. Her gaze holds a mixture of mild reproach and amusement.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: That's not even your unit. If I'm not worried, my advisor, you shouldn't be. Your only job right now is to dance.
As she speaks, she deftly twists her wrist, guiding you through a partial turn to avoid a collision before sweeping you back to the center of the floor in one elegant arc.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: My people are strong. If I say they'll win, they will win. Consider this a victory celebration in advance.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Or... do you have a problem with your partner?
Of course not. A quick glance around tells you everything: people are either mocking those fashionable sunglasses you're wearing or envying your luck for being with such a beautiful woman.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: That'll do. Now, follow my lead. You workaholics never know how to handle these parties, do you? Watch and learn.

You step forward under her guidance. Her hand rests on your shoulder, her face turned to yours. The scent of her perfume—a rich bloom mingled with temple incense—wafts under your nose, and her hair whispers against your cheek.
steps.female_content: You step forward under her guidance. Her hand rests on your waist, her face turned to yours. The scent of her perfume—a rich bloom mingled with temple incense—wafts under your nose, and her hair whispers against your cheek.

steps.content: Yet your thoughts are still far from here. With every turn she leads you through, the surrounding conversations slice through the music, pulling your attention, fragment by fragment.

steps.speaker: Crowd A
steps.content: Fraser has issued an urgent announcement calling for peace... but have you heard the real story? They're saying the farlands engineered these Tides of Ashes. My God, what are they even capable of now? I should've moved my assets earlier...

steps.speaker: Crowd B
steps.content: And what are our diplomats doing? Absolutely nothing! The shipping lanes are a mess, and I can't even get goods to the satellite towns. You know what that is? It's me, losing money. Every. Single. Day.

steps.speaker: Crowd C
steps.content: Really? My Eastian immigration consultancy is booming. Looking for a new investment opportunity?

steps.speaker: Crowd A
steps.content: Immigration? Can anyone even get out anymore? I heard that ghost unit is back at WhiteSands... yeah, DisCorps... This damned war...

Tomorrow, the city-state council will once again vote on the Wartime Emergency Resolution. And so today, philanthropists, socialites, councilors, magnates, and intellectuals have gathered here under the guise of a "ball" to exchange intelligence and form alliances.

—Yes, this is an "anti-war" gathering, and most of those present are Augustus's "enemies." Yet none of them recognize this mysterious general, who seems solely devoted to indulging in the evening's lavish pleasures.
To the rhythm of the carefree music, she pivots, using your frame for balance. The motion brings her face to yours, and your gazes lock.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Is this your kind of scene?

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Better than chasing game through some manor's grounds. After the non-stop action, a night of elegance—even if it's put on—is a good change. Lets you play dress-up and listen to these aristocrats' sheltered little jokes.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Call it a decadent upper-class hobby. You should try it. Could be a fun distraction.
[Enter Flashback] MBCC

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: I know about the Andohars. Their entire wealth was built on arms dealing. They were a major factor in the last stages of the Independence War and the development of the satellite towns.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: I heard they weren't originally allies with DisCity; they primarily armed the metropoles. They only established ties with DisCity once the independence forces started to win, so they profited from both sides.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: They're not as powerful now. What's an arms dealer without an army, after all? But they're still everywhere in high society. I guess war really is good for business.
[Exit Flashback]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I still have contamination on me. If I lose control, it could cause serious trouble.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Haha, you're worried about causing trouble? Even if you did, no one would dare touch you. I promise.
[Enter Flashback] Phone Call

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: The draft resolution is facing considerable opposition. On the surface, it's certain Eastside factions trying to limit the FAC's authority. But what concerns me is that the FAC itself opposes several clauses. That's... strange.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: They're clearly afraid of something else...
[Exit Flashback]
Lost in thought, your foot comes down on your partner's toes—for the sixth time. A breathy laugh escapes her as her hand gives your shoulder a gentle squeeze.
steps.female_content: Lost in thought, your foot comes down on your partner's toes—for the sixth time. A breathy laugh escapes her as her hand presses slightly against your waist.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Hey, relax. You're wound way too tight. No one here knows the Chief of MBCC is working with us. FAC and the 9th Agency aren't gonna talk.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: To this city, you're still the hero who quelled the rebellion at the Great Expo. The last thing they want is anyone finding out we're working together.
The music happens to slow down.
And you no longer feel the need to hide your true thoughts.

steps.speaker: Option
options: But you seem like you want people to notice.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Our deal was for the battlefield—hunting the Black Ring, hitting the Outlands. It was supposed to be quiet. So why drop my name to get me here? What's your game?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is this about sizing up your opposition? The ones blocking the mobilization order. The future obstacles. Don't insult me by pretending this is just a party.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: I was thinking... this is a good piece, and you're not a terrible dancer. Would've been a nice dance to finish.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Pity you're not actually here to enjoy it.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: If you're not interested, just let go of my hand and get back to your MBCC. You can have the car you came in. The black triangle knows how to drive it. It'll take you back home.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Don't force it. I don't need reluctant partners.
As she speaks, her grip on your hand loosens, a silent promise to let go.
As the music's final notes fill the room, the dance floor stirs back to life. You take the lead, guiding her through the final turn, finally in sync with her steps.
steps.female_content: As the music's final notes fill the room, the dance floor stirs back to life. Your hand moves from her shoulder to her waist as you take the lead, guiding her through the final turn. This time, you don't miss a single step.

steps.content: Until the music ends.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not opposed to bending the rules. Frankly, I could use a little "extra" help myself. But this partnership only works if we're straight with each other. No more games.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've got my own war to fight, General. I'm not just another asset for you to deploy. Is that satisfying enough for you?
She looks at you, and a smile spreads across her face.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: ...Not a bad lead. I'm satisfied. The floor's all yours—enjoy the rest of the ball.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Just don't overthink it. Your first and foremost job tonight is to unwind. Which means this...

With a sweet smile, she casually plucks the sunglasses from your face—the very pair she gave you, along with the communication device. She simply walks away, taking your only terminal for messages from Broken Blade Squad 3 with her.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: ...is going back where it belongs.
Without your sunglasses, you're quickly recognized by the people around you.

steps.speaker: Crowd A
steps.content: Ah, if it isn't the Chief of MBCC! I knew you were a person of justice, a real peacemaker! Please, come join us!
Catherine's hand slips from yours. Her smile is the last thing you see before she is swallowed by the bustling throng on the dance floor, leaving you suddenly alone.
Over an hour later...
After several rounds of "exchanges," you've taken the measure of the ball's attendees.
Their motivations are a predictable mix: fear of financial cost, anxiety over lost business, and sheer political vendetta. You find yourself constantly courted and led back to the dance floor.

Meanwhile, some self-proclaimed activists organize anti-war protests while secretly plotting violence against public facilities, particularly FAC installations. Others simply avoid your gaze. You commit several suspicious faces to memory for a later report to the 9th Agency.
It's time to leave. The spectacle is becoming unbearable. Though you genuinely despise war, here the word "peace" is like a clay statue slathered in thick makeup—sticky, hollow, and nauseating.
The cognitive dissonance is suffocating. You excuse yourself to the restroom, splashing cold water on your face in a desperate bid for a moment of clarity.
And then, as you step out, you are cornered once more.

steps.speaker: Anti-War Activist
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}? I work over at the Council. I was hoping to ask you about the recent raid on Euphoria.

steps.speaker: Anti-War Activist
steps.content: I heard you were one of the people who organized the whole operation—that you were even on the front lines. But... the Sinners from MBCC are all contaminated; they can't fight. And the FAC, they don't get involved in police actions like that.

steps.speaker: Anti-War Activist
steps.content: So... who did you take with you? It wasn't... it wasn't those Nirvana rebels from WhiteSands, was it?
You become high on alert.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Every last one of them at Euphoria was a traitor. If you have a problem with that, take it up with the 9th Agency. Unless you're afraid to. What's the matter? You got friends there?

steps.speaker: Anti-War Activist
steps.content: No, no, I have nothing to do with that shadowy group! And anyway, the 9th Agency's been investigating them inside and out. There's no way the Sillage Society would dare make a move right now. You have to believe me!

steps.speaker: Anti-War Activist
steps.content: I'm just... I'm worried about you. I think you've been marked by warmongers. Please, please be careful.
You turn back, and that look is all the encouragement he needs.

steps.speaker: Anti-War Activist
steps.content: The military clique back then... they were all ambitious. Brutal. They'd always believed in rule through force. After they seized power, they brought nothing but suffering to the city-state. For twelve years.

steps.speaker: Anti-War Activist
steps.content: My family lived through that, persecuted by them. I haven't forgotten... I can't.

steps.speaker: Anti-War Activist
steps.content: Back then, DisCity expanded through bloody campaigns abroad while tightening its grip at home. They'd start wars to distract from their failures. Violence was always their answer.

steps.speaker: Anti-War Activist
steps.content: It took everything we had to correct those mistakes. To overthrow them, drive out those dangerous elements...

steps.speaker: Anti-War Activist
steps.content: But they never really left. They never disbanded. They're still drifting through WhiteSands like ghosts... It just proves they haven't given up. They're waiting—waiting for a chance to reclaim power...

steps.speaker: Anti-War Activist
steps.content: I've heard they have a new leader now. Last year, they forced their way into the FAC. And now... now they're using you. For what, I don't even know.
[Enter Flashback]

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: You want to launch a full-scale rescue for a little subordinate of yours? Sure, I'll do it. Frankly, you won't find anyone else crazy enough to say yes.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Don't hold it against them. A real war costs a fortune, and a B-Class Sinner like her is just not worth that price tag. Not to mention, you're going in blind. It's a terrible plan.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: But you? You're worth the gamble. I believe in investing in people who have potential.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: You'll return the favor someday, won't you?
[Exit Flashback]

steps.speaker: Anti-War Activist
steps.content: Chief, don't trust them. However this plays out. You can't let them take control of DisCity again. They're—

His face is a mask of worry, his words dipped in earnestness. Yet, a sliver of doubt remains. In these treacherous times, even the hands of your so-called collaborator feel perilously close to your back.
In the end, only one thing is certain...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't have any comment on the mobilization order. Everything I do serves one purpose. Peace or war—I'll walk whichever path gets me closer to my goal. Nothing else matters to me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not the ally you're looking for. There are other things I need to handle. Good day.

steps.speaker: Anti-War Activist
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}!
You shrink from his presence and walk down the corridor. But as you look up, the passage melts away, depositing you back into the overwhelming swirl of the ballroom.
Is it the stirring of your shackles that sharpens your senses? The chaotic din of the crowd, once a dull roar, now crashes upon you—each laugh, each whisper, a razor-sharp provocation.

steps.speaker: Crowd B
steps.content: You know, if that incident at the Great Expo never happened... we wouldn't be in this mess. Sometimes I wonder, was that the old military's doing? Is that why Fraser's peace talks keep failing...?

steps.speaker: Crowd B
steps.content: And this resolution we're voting on... You think those war hawks engineered this, too?

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Don't even get me started... The demand for Hypercubes is already stretching our production to its absolute limit. And now the Speaker expects us to play nice and make concessions to the West District?

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: That man parlayed a single Expo incident into a reputation, and now it's gone straight to his head.

Are they discussing peace? Certainly. They speak of averting war—and like you, they profess a hatred for conflict. Yet, a subtle dissonance begins to weave through the conversation, humming just beneath their words.

steps.speaker: Crowd A
steps.content: The vote is just a few days away... And you know, that MBCC Chief! What if we could get him to influence Speaker King? Maybe even sit directly at the negotiating table.
steps.female_content: The vote is just a few days away... And you know, that MBCC Chief! What if we could get her to influence Speaker King? Maybe even sit directly at the negotiating table.

steps.speaker: Crowd A
steps.content: Think about it, he's the hero who fought the Black Rings. Fraser could broker an introduction to the Farland Alliance. And we pitch it as a joint operation: we help them suppress the Black Ring, and in return... we get access to new mining territories. We can develop the resources together. Peacefully.
steps.female_content: Think about it, she's the hero who fought the Black Rings. Fraser could broker an introduction to the Farland Alliance. And we pitch it as a joint operation: we help them suppress the Black Ring, and in return... we get access to new mining territories. We can develop the resources together. Peacefully.

steps.speaker: Crowd A
steps.content: See? Every crisis is just an opportunity in disguise...
A wave of nausea washes over you, blurring your vision. Is BR-005 acting up? You push to your feet, scanning the glittering room for Catherine.

You need to find her. To tell her your work is done, that she must honor her promise to take you back to the battlefield. Hella is still out there, somewhere beyond your sight, and every second in this gilded cage is a second too long.

Several people spot you, reaching out with polished smiles to take your arm. Their unwanted touch is a trigger. Something primal and hungry stirs beneath your skin, straining to pierce through the surface.
(use an onomatopoeia word here)
And in that exact moment, a piercing Mania alarm shreds the air, sending waves of fear through the crowd.

steps.speaker: Crowd B
steps.content: Mania contamination? Or robbers?

steps.speaker: Crowd B
steps.content: What? The alarm system malfunctioned? Seriously, how could they mess up like—
You freeze. Could the Mania outbreak... be because of you? Did you lose control of your emotions again?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: It was me, Chief. I infiltrated the Mania detection system here and made some minor tweaks.
The pocket on your chest vibrates slightly. It's Schorl.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Your Mania levels have spiked beyond the safety parameters. I'm afraid you can't stay here any longer. And before you worry, the cause may not be emotional.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I'm detecting an anomaly from the WhiteSands front line. The source could be an issue with BR-005. You should return to investigate. I believe you'd prefer that, anyway.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I will inform General Augustus that you received an urgent recall to MBCC. There's no need for anyone to know about this.
You force your head up. On the second-floor balcony, a woman's gaze meets yours. She offers a faint smile and raises her wine glass in a silent toast—her expression clearly saying "you've got this."

She seems utterly indifferent to the fate of her frontline troops. Swathed in elegance and savoring fine wine, her relaxed, carefree demeanor is indistinguishable from the other high-society guests at this grotesque gala.
Another wave of nausea washes over you. You have to look away.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll let you deal with the report to her. I need to get out of here and check in with the front line, ASAP.
Meanwhile, at the Ashes Frontline you've been worried about—
[Battlefield]

Though the Apostles roar and storms rage, even the wild laughter of the Aurum Secretum Sinner cannot drive back the DisCorps soldiers, who hold their ground behind cover, their eyes fixed on the distant horizon.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: There's no need to retreat. Stand fast, everyone.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: Command confirms reinforcements are inbound. Our mission is to buy them time.
